cases.question: 复购用户率是多少？请按真实用户 customer_unique_id 计算。

tool_steps.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_with_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_users,
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)

GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC, purchase_month ASC
LIMIT 5;
